corporate_events.detail:
Waktu: 14:00:00 · Lokasi: DKI Jakarta · Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, consolidated financial statements, and PUMK report, while ratifying restated financial statements for the 2023 and 2024 fiscal years. The Board of Directors and Commissioners were granted full discharge (acquit et de charge) for their oversight and management during the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of Rp1.31 trillion in net profit, designating 50% as cash dividends and 50% as retained earnings. The Board of Directors was authorized to establish the payment schedule and manage procedures for dividend distribution.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to determine salaries, honorariums, facilities, and performance-based remuneration for the company's management. This applies to the 2026 fiscal year and 2025 performance results in accordance with prevailing regulations.
Agenda #4: Shareholders appointed KAP Purwanto Susanti dan Surja (Ernst & Young Global Limited) to audit the 2026 consolidated financial statements and PUMK reports. The Board of Commissioners was authorized to set audit fees and appoint a replacement firm if the primary firm is unable to complete its services.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved delegating the authority to approve the 2026-2030 Long-Term Plan (RJPP) and 2027 Budget (RKAP) to the Board of Commissioners, subject to written approval from the majority Series B Shareholder. This process must be coordinated with the Series A Dwiwarna Shareholder and follow good corporate governance.
Agenda #6: The meeting approved amending Article 3 of the Articles of Association regarding the company's purpose and business activities to align with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI). The Board of Directors was granted authority to perform all necessary legal and notarial actions to implement these changes.
Agenda #7: Shareholders confirmed the discharge of Suhendra Yusuf Ratuprawiranegara, restructured directorate titles, and reassigned Harry Budi Sidharta and Ratih Mayasari to new roles. The meeting confirmed the new board composition, including the appointment of Restu Widiyantoro as President Director.
